subject: Comp exception request: accelerated equity + spot bonus for promotion
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Andrea Lowe <andrea@peopleopsco.com>
Date: 2025-11-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Comp exception request: accelerated equity + spot bonus for promotion

Hi Laura / Monica —

I'm requesting a compensation exception for Priya N. (Staff ML Engineer) following an accelerated promotion we completed last week (effective 2025-11-01). Summary and request below: 

- Rationale: Priya was promoted to Staff for cross-team core infra work; market signals indicate she is ~15% below market on total comp for comparable Staff roles in our cohort. We have a retention risk (two recruit outcomes stalled this quarter).
- Proposed package changes (one-time exception):
  - Spot cash bonus: $18,000 (one-time, fiscal code: ENG-RET-2025)
  - Equity refresh: accelerated refresh granting 0.05% (level-appropriate) with prorated vest schedule to sync with company refresh cadence
  - No base salary increase beyond standard calibration this cycle (we're requesting equity + spot to avoid band compression)
- Budget owner: Engineering head (Rishi) approves in principle; marking for Finance confirmation.

Attached: comp_proposal_markus_klein.pdf (breakdown, benchmarking), calibration_notes_2025Q4.docx.

Ask: Laura, can People Ops sign off on exception form and confirm any required approvals? Monica / Finance — can you confirm the spot bonus and equity refresh fit within our Q4 exception budget and provide any coding/chargeback instructions?

I can provide a one-page manager justification for exec review if needed. Want to finalize before 11/17 so we can include in Nov payroll / refresh window.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-11-10T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Comp exception request: accelerated equity + spot bonus for promotion

Thanks Markus — quick clarifying Qs before I loop in Execs and Andrea from PeopleOps Consulting:

1) Promotion effective date you listed is 11/01/2025 — please confirm that's the formal promotion date on the HR record.
2) Can you attach the manager calibration note (format: manager name, summary of performance, comp rationale) — you referenced it but I don't see the calibration doc in the PDF (if it is separate, please resend).
3) Confirmation this is a one-time spot + equity refresh request rather than a base salary uplift; any expected salary cadence changes?
4) Please confirm funding source and GL code (if Finance doesn't approve the ENG-RET-2025 code we need alternative).

Process notes: For equity exceptions we route to Compensation -> Legal (for grant docs) -> Payroll. If the total comp uplift (annualized) exceeds 10% we'd require Exec approval for base adjustments; since this is spot + equity, we may be able to expedite.

Link to exception form: https://drive.google.com/open?id=comp-exception-form-2025 (please complete if not already done).

If you can get those items to me this afternoon I can kick off the workflow.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-11-11T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Comp exception request: accelerated equity + spot bonus for promotion

Markus / Laura —

Finance can provisionally approve the requested one-time spot bonus and the equity refresh within Q4 exception limits with the following conditions: 

- Spot cash: capped at $18,000 as requested — approved for payment in Nov payroll provided paperwork is received by 2025-11-17 COB. Charge to GL ENG-RET-2025.
- Equity refresh: approved up to 0.05% (as a refresh grant). Compensation team must provide final grant language; Legal to sign off. We will need eq_refresh_ledger.csv entry for tracking (attached).
- If any proposed annualized change to base salary >10% appears (not in current ask), escalate to Exec Compensation Committee (Rishi / CEO sign-off).
- Please include a one-line business justification for audit trail in the HubSpot HR ticket (link to HR-7321).

I've attached eq_refresh_ledger.csv and my calibration notes in calibration_notes_2025Q4.docx for the record. Once People Ops completes the exception form and Compensation finalizes grant text, Finance will release the spot bonus to Payroll.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Finance Business Partner
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Andrea Lowe <andrea@peopleopsco.com>
Date: 2025-11-12T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Comp exception request: accelerated equity + spot bonus for promotion

Appreciate the quick review and the provisional approvals.

Actions from my side: 
- I'll complete the exception form and upload the manager justification and promotion confirmation to the HR ticket (HR-7321) today.
- I'll coordinate with Compensation to finalize grant language and loop Legal for sign-off.
- Rishi / I will schedule a 15-min sync with Laura to confirm wording we use with the employee (we want to be clear about vesting/proration).

Payroll timing noted (paperwork by 11/17). Monica — we'll ensure GL code ENG-RET-2025 is used.

Markus
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
